NOVARTIS ANNOUNCED TODAY THAT COMMITTEE FOR MEDICINAL PRODUCTS FOR HUMAN USE (CHMP) OF EUROPEAN MEDICINES AGENCY (EMA) HAS ADOPTED A POSITIVE OPINION RECOMMENDING MARKETING AUTHORIZATION FOR COSENTYX(®) (SECUKINUMAB) IN POLYMYALGIA RHEUMATICA (PMR).⁸
OPINION SUPPORTS COSENTYX USE FOR TREATMENT OF PMR IN ADULTS WHO HAVE HAD AN INADEQUATE RESPONSE TO STEROIDS OR WHO EXPERIENCE RELAPSE DURING STEROID TAPER
POSITIVE CHMP OPINION IS SUPPORTED BY RESULTS FROM PIVOTAL REPLENISH PHASE III TRIAL
FOLLOWING CHMP RECOMMENDATION FOR APPROVAL, EUROPEAN COMMISSION (EC) IS EXPECTED TO ISSUE A FINAL DECISION WITHIN APPROXIMATELY TWO MONTHS.
